close_reason: Implemented in commit 8d8b6c5. Added MetadataSetParams, MetadataGetParams, MetadataQueryParams, MetadataQueryChangesParams — each empty-but-for-the-extra-flatten field (since draft-01 defines no method-level extras for these four). Re-exported from lib.rs. Threaded through each method builder as 'params: Option<...>' final positional. Vendor extras propagate via merge_extras helper using Map::entry.or_insert (typed fields win on collision).
description: Cookie-cutter gap vs canonical mail-client. mail-client/src/methods/mod.rs defines MailboxSetParams, EmailCopyParams, EmailSubmissionSetParams, EmailGetParams, EmailParseParams — each Serialize struct carries an 'extra' flatten field for vendor method-level args. metadata-client only defines MetadataChangesParams (for /changes). The other four method builders (metadata_set, metadata_get, metadata_query, metadata_query_changes) have no equivalent struct, so a vendor that wants to send e.g. acmeCorpAuditFlag: true as a method-level arg on Metadata/set must bypass this crate entirely (build a JmapRequest by hand). The workspace extras-preservation policy explicitly classes 'method-argument structs in *-client crates' as in scope. PLAN.md §New-type rule even acknowledges this hypothetically. Trigger: vendor extension that decorates standard JMAP methods. Fix: introduce MetadataSetParams, MetadataGetParams, MetadataQueryParams, MetadataQueryChangesParams — each carrying only the extras flatten initially (since draft-01 defines no method-level extras for those four), and accept Option<…Params> as a final arg on each builder, mirroring MailboxSetParams. Lower-bound work, but the API shape decision should fossilise before downstream consumers start calling these builders.
title: metadata_set: no MetadataSetParams escape hatch for vendor method-level extras
